versions.changelog:
- Initial release of LoomLens Live for OpenClaw.
- Opens a sidebar panel to show real-time cost estimates and model recommendations for prompts.
- Supports 6 model clusters, with dynamic recommendations and per-call billing.
- Allows drag & drop text, keyboard shortcut (`Cmd/Ctrl+L`), and model override for the next prompt.
- Offers freemium access (3 free runs/day) and integrates Signal Loom rev-share for developers.
- Easy installation via workspace hook or skill installer (when supported).
